description: Source code implementing mock DNS socket factory and server socket classes for testing, including methods for sending, receiving, and simulating network packets within the 'net' namespace.

classes.name: MockMDnsDatagramServerSocket
classes.description: Mock implementation of a datagram server socket for mDNS, supporting send and receive operations.

classes.name: MockMDnsSocketFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating mock mDNS datagram server sockets, with methods to simulate network behavior.

methods.name: SendTo
methods.description: Sends data to a specified address, internally calling SendToInternal.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of the socket.

methods.name: SetResponsePacket
methods.description: Sets the response packet data for simulated reception.

methods.name: HandleRecvNow
methods.description: Handles immediate reception of data, copying response packet into buffer.

methods.name: HandleRecvLater
methods.description: Handles delayed reception, posting a task to invoke callback.

methods.name: CreateSockets
methods.description: Creates IPv4 and IPv6 sockets and adds them to the provided vector.

methods.name: CreateSocket
methods.description: Creates a mock socket for a specific address family and sets up default behaviors.

methods.name: SimulateReceive
methods.description: Simulates receiving a packet by copying data into buffer and invoking callback.

methods.name: RecvFromInternal
methods.description: Prepares buffer and callback for receiving data asynchronously.

methods.name: SendToInternal
methods.description: Handles internal send operation, invoking OnSendTo and returning packet size.
